{{Quote|Who'd've thought I'd find myself back in the ''Descent Ghetto''! Home, stinky home!|Cad Bane|<ref name="bvb">{{TCWComicCite|6.46|Bane vs ...Bane?}}</ref>}}
The '''Descent Ghetto''' was a crime-ridden district of [[New Tayana]], a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[City/Legends|city]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Soopan]] established himself as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] within the Descent Ghetto by impersonating his old friend [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], a former city resident who had developed a formidable reputation as a successful [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. In around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Bane returned to the Descent Ghetto to confront Soopan and stop him from masquerading as Bane.
